foundation.framingA.title: Waa kulankeenii kowaad.
foundation.framingA.body:
Toddobo su'aalood oo deggan — laakiin waad joojin kartaa saddex kadib oo aad aragtaa akhriskaaga koowaad.

Wax jawaabo sax ah ma jiraan. Daacadaddu way ka wanaagsan tahay cajab gelinta.

Kani ma aha imtixaan. Waa sawirka ugu horreeya ee meesha aad joogto hadda, si aan halkaas kuugu soo buuxiyo.
foundation.framingA.skip: Ka bood hadda - isticmaal habraaca caadiga ah
foundation.framingB.title: Kani waa aasaaskaaga.
foundation.framingB.body:
Waxa aad hadda i siisay wuxuu noqonayaa suunkaaga bilowga ah.

 maalmaha soo socda waxaan sii wadi doonaa dib-u-habeynta - kani ma aha imtixaan, waa sawirka ugu horreeya.
foundation.qcard.skipAhead: Horay u bood — tus akhriskayga hadda
foundation.q1.title: Waa kuwee qaababkani oo si xoog leh ugu dhex socda adiga hadda?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Ilaa 3. Daacad noqo.
foundation.q1.opt1: Kuma filna — wax ku filan maayo ma samaynayo
foundation.q1.opt2: Xakameynta — haddii aan sii daayo, wax walba way burburayaan
foundation.q1.opt4: Welwelka — cabsi isku mid ah, sheeko isku mid ah, gunti isku mid ah
foundation.q1.opt8: Ghe / u ts'in — u biya, mu t'u
foundation.q2.title: Kha pa hmi kja o ts'a gi k'o ra t'u?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Mi nchii. K'o gi kja to kjuand'u kja peme.
foundation.q2.opt1: Beni — ko tji ch'ii, pa si'i pjaa
foundation.q2.opt2: Rri — nu hmi kja to gimi, kjuats'i
foundation.q2.opt3: Pjeje — nji ts'e tapas, nji ts'e kjuax'a
foundation.q2.opt4: Monastiko — nji ts'e pa hmi kja x'i nza
foundation.q3.title: Nu gi t'u tji k'o gi zo gi ntee, gi...
foundation.q3.opt1: Ndzama — nu mi peme, nu mi pjaa
foundation.q3.opt4: Ndihi — kjuamii, ndzii, o ra ts'e nza
foundation.q3.opt5: Ndi xiki mi — ntee k'o nti mi t'e
foundation.q3.opt6: Tji kjuamii k'o ntee k'a pjaa
foundation.q3.opt7: Mbe nu kjuamii — xji, ntsii, kja
foundation.q3.opt8: Peme hmi k'o nte mii t'e ra
foundation.q3.opt11: Mbe kja nza, tji ko t'e
foundation.q3.opt12: Muhiima — ficilo yar, si wanaagsan loo qabtay
foundation.q4.title: Waa tee albaabka kuugu dhow hadda?
foundation.q4.opt1: H<bos>1/4N-H_n / C1/4N-H_n — muusiko, ilmada, is dhiibid
foundation.q4.opt6: Kazi ya nguvu — pumzi, mbinu ya ndani, uhai
foundation.q5.title: Uko hapa kufikiria nini upya?
foundation.q5.opt3: Walaan ka'to ku'i ka uba mban o'onaa
foundation.q5.opt5: Walaan ka'to ku'i ka ginaa o'on
foundation.q6.title: Wani kowaa n'a yii tuu?
foundation.q6.opt2: Gaa n'uun wani t'iina ku'i kowaa mban
foundation.q7.title: Marka wax adag dhaco, xagee u tagtaa marka hore?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Ogow dhaqaaqa ugu horreeya.
foundation.q7.opt1: Maskaxdayda — falanqee, qorshee, dib u ciyaar
foundation.q7.opt3: Kooseeyis — koochiyis, sirriisis, waan tokko hojjedhu
foundation.q8.title: Yaada kee of eeguuf hammam barameerta?
foundation.q8.opt4: Ma a rayuwatawa ce mai dorewa
foundation.analysis.subtitle: Wannan zai canza yayin da kake aiki. Ba komai bane a tsaida - wannan shine babban batu.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: Za mu sake karanta wannan a duk 'yan kwanaki. Kungiyoyi suna motsawa. Wannan shine babban batu.
foundation.brain.head.label: Wanda ke karkashin jagorancin kai
foundation.brain.heart.label: Wanda ke karkashin jagorancin zuciya
foundation.brain.gut.label: Dii-dhiga
foundation.brain.head.line: Gariin ma xasuusataa. Waan sharciyeynaa, ka dibna waxaan baraynaa jirka inuu soo gaaro.
foundation.brain.heart.line: Waxaad dareentaa marka hore. Waan ilaalineynaa taas, waxaana ku dareynaa markhaati gadaashiisa ah.
foundation.brain.gut.line: Waxaad dhaqaaqdaa marka hore. Waan yara yareyn doonaa si aad u maqashid waxa hoos ku jira.
foundation.analysis.loopsEmpty: Wax qaylo ah ma jiraan weli — waan heli doonaa inta aan suuqyada ku jirno.
foundation.analysis.returnNote: Ungabuyela ekufundeni kwakho kamuva kusuka kuzilungiselelo. Ayikho into eyisiphetho.
foundation.paths.title: Khetha abahamba nabo.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Ukubona kuyisisekelo — yonke indlela iqala lapho. Khetha izindlela ezingu-2–3 ezizwakala zipila kuwe njengamanje. Ungangeza ezinye kamuva.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Ukubuka okukhona, ngaphandle kokubamba noma ukucindezela. Yonke indlela esihamba ngayo ndawonye iqala kulesi sihlalo.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Tani waa bartaada bilowga ah — ee ma aha qafas. Wadadaadu way horumaraysaa sida adiga oo kale.
foundation.archetype.creator: Abuuraha
foundation.path.kriya.blurb: Shaqada tamarta ee neefsashada iyo farsamada gudaha.
foundation.path.karma.blurb: Ficil aan ku xirnayn. Adeeg sida duco.
foundation.path.bhakti.blurb: Cibaado. U oggolaanshaha wadnaha inuu hor kaco.
foundation.path.jnana.blurb: Baaritaan. Jarista dhagarta oo leh caddayn.
foundation.path.tantra.blurb: Wax kasta waa barakeysan yihiin. Waxba lagama reebo.
foundation.path.dhyana.blurb: Fadhi aamusnaan ah. Qoto dheer iyada oo loo marayo degganaansho.
